name: Nongriat (Living Root Bridges)
source_label: East Khasi Hills District Administration — Police directory + meghealth.gov.in CHC list (parent: Sohra)
notes: Nongriat (double-decker living root bridge village) is a 3500-step trek down from Tyrna village; NO infrastructure at site itself — rescue routes through Tyrna trailhead → Sohra. Closest govt facility: Sohra CHC (~12 km from Tyrna trailhead, plus the trek-out time which can be 2-3 hours). Sohra PS 03637-235227 (https://eastkhasihills.gov.in/police/) handles Nongriat catchment. Sohra CHC on meghealth.gov.in CHC list. Backup: Civil Hospital Shillong ~62 km from Sohra. State Disaster Helpline 1077 + Police 100 / 0364-2222277. NO dedicated mountain-rescue service published on any .gov.in page → mountain_rescue null (life-safety: rescue is informal via local guides + DDMA). Pharmacy/mechanic/tow/guesthouse/EN-doctor not on any .gov.in page → null.
